definitions.gloss: wild boar meat; boar served as food
definitions.explanation: Meat from wild boar, especially as served in restaurants. {牡丹|ぼたん} (peony) refers to the flower-like way the slices are arranged on the plate.

examples.japanese: {牡丹肉|ぼたんにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牡丹肉|ぼたんにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Wild boar hot pot is delicious in winter.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}あい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧で、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{獲|と}れた{牡丹肉|ぼたんにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わった→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧。
examples.english: At an inn in the mountains, we tasted locally caught wild boar meat.

notes:
A traditional euphemism for boar meat. Eating four-legged animals was long discouraged in Japan, so game meats acquired flower and plant names that avoided naming the animal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}{鍋|なべ}→牡丹鍋：30498_botannabe⟧: wild boar hot pot (the most common way it is served)
- {牡丹肉|ぼたんにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧: to stew boar meat
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧{仕立|じた}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}{鍋|なべ}→牡丹鍋：30498_botannabe⟧: miso-based boar hot pot

RELATED GAME-MEAT NAMES:
- もみじ: venison — literally 'maple leaves'
- さくら: horse meat — literally 'cherry blossom'
- かしわ: chicken — an older regional term
